manufacturer_data.description: Ruuvi (0x0499); decode by the leading format byte (0x05 / 0x03).

methods.notes: Passive scan: match company id 0x0499, decode DF5 (or legacy DF3).

manufacturer_data.description: Ruuvi Innovations. The first payload byte selects the format (0x05 = DF5 / RAWv2, 0x03 = DF3 / RAWv1). Name prefix "Ruuvi".

device.name: RuuviTag Environmental Sensor

openness.notes: Ruuvi publishes the data formats and firmware; nothing was reverse- engineered. Company id 0x0499 is Ruuvi's own SIG assignment.

upstream_docs.covers: The 24-byte DF5 payload layout and company id 0x0499.
upstream_docs.title: Ruuvi — Data Format 5 (RAWv2)

credentials.notes: No pairing/auth; measurements are broadcast in the clear. No Wi-Fi.

factory_reset.effect: Firmware reflash / a bootloader gesture exists but is not a broadcast reset and is not transcribed here. The tag stores no network/cloud state.

methods.description: Passive: scan for company id 0x0499 and decode the DF5 (or DF3) payload. No connection required.

steps.action: Scan for company id 0x0499 and decode the manufacturer-data payload per its format byte.

setup.notes: Nothing to provision: the tag ships broadcasting. A magnet/button and the Ruuvi Station app can change the interval, but the sensor stream needs no onboarding.

rejoin.notes: No network membership; reading is passive.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The DF5/DF3 byte layouts and company id 0x0499 are from Ruuvi's own published data-format documentation.

helpful_urls.description: The 24-byte DF5 payload layout and company id 0x0499.
helpful_urls.title: Ruuvi — Data Format 5 (RAWv2)

data_format_5.description: RAWv2 (DF5), 24-byte manufacturer-data payload; multi-byte fields MSB-first.

fields.description: u16 @5, 1 Pa; decode as raw + 50000 Pa (value_offset); 0xFFFF invalid.
fields.name: pressure

parse_rules: A leading byte 0x03 is the legacy 14-byte DF3 layout instead; decode accordingly.
Treat the per-field sentinel values (0x8000 / 0xFFFF / 0xFF) as invalid.

services.name: Generic Access (standard)
services.notes: Placeholder connectable surface. RuuviTag telemetry is in the manufacturer advertisement (company id 0x0499), decoded in payload_formats. Firmware also offers a Nordic UART GATT for history on some builds (not documented here).
